general_entrance.text: Applicants must satisfy the University general entrance requirements and the entrance requirements specific to individual programmes. For master's programmes, applicants must hold a bachelor's degree from one of the universities in Hong Kong or from an overseas institution recognised for this purpose by the University, or such other qualifications as the University deems equivalent. Final-year undergraduates who will acquire the qualification before the programme starts may apply.

english.text: Applicants whose entrance qualification was obtained from an institution where the medium of instruction is not English should meet a minimum of TOEFL iBT 79, or IELTS overall 6, or band 6 in the Chinese mainland College English Test, or other equivalent qualifications. documents: University application procedure (College of Business master's application-procedure page), not restated as a programme-specific checklist: official degree award certificate; transcript with overall GPA/average marks; English test report if applicable; online verification report issued by CSSD for verification of degrees obtained in mainland China.
Supporting documents are uploaded online. Submission by email or post is not accepted.
programs.interview: Applicants with an IELTS overall band score of 6.0 or a TOEFL overall score of 4 must pass an English-proficiency interview conducted by the academic unit. Applicants with a comparable TOEFL overall score of 79 or above shown on the TOEFL report may be exempt from that interview. Interviews for other applicants may not be required.

tuition.text: HKD 399,000 on the programme page and the College tuition list.

official_quotes: possess a recognized Bachelor’s degree with Second Class Honours or above, or the equivalent.
